We need answer Chinese physics multiple choice. Need analyze.

Problem: Two bottles of different ideal gases, same temperature and pressure, different volumes. What relations: number density n (molecules per unit volume), total translational kinetic energy per unit volume (E_K/V), mass density rho. Options:
A n different, E_K/V different, rho different
B n different, E_K/V different, rho same
C n same, E_K/V same, rho different
D n same, E_K/V same, rho same

We need select. Ideal gas: p = n k T (number density n). Same T, p => n same. Total translational kinetic energy per molecule = (3/2) k T for ideal gas (monatomic? But translational only for all: average translational KE = 3/2 kT). Total per volume = n * 3/2 kT = (3/2) p, so same if p same. Mass density rho = mass per volume = n * molecular mass m0. Different gases have different molecular masses, so rho different. Thus C. Need final line exactly "答案：C". Provide concise explanation maybe. Ensure last line.
content:
由理想气体状态方程的微观形式：

\[
p=nkT
\]

两瓶气体的压强 \(p\) 和温度 \(T\) 相同，因此单位体积内的分子数

\[
n=\frac{p}{kT}
\]

相同。

单位体积内分子的总平动动能为：

\[
\frac{E_K}{V}=n\cdot \frac{3}{2}kT=\frac{3}{2}p
\]

压强相同，所以 \(\frac{E_K}{V}\) 也相同。

但两种气体的分子质量不同，因此单位体积内的气体质量，即密度

\[
\rho = nm_0
\]

不同。

答案：C
